findings.label: Backfilled telemetry config overwrites current config
findings.detail: import_lines routes telemetry-message lines to upsert_telemetry_config, which unconditionally replaces stored EQNS/UNIT/PARM; an older metadata set in the paste wins over the newer live one, and re-runs count them as imported again. Skip telemetry-message lines in backfill, apply only when no config exists, or document it.

findings.label: Live-plus-imported duplicates
findings.detail: Dedup key (callsign, raw, received_at) follows the spec, but a packet received live and also imported from aprs.fi is stored twice seconds apart. Add a README note to import only periods the server was offline.

findings.label: Case-sensitive callsign URL
findings.detail: /weather/a/yg2ufh-10 shows the empty state because lookups are exact-match; upper-case the callsign in callsignFromPath().

findings.label: Misleading fetch-error text
findings.detail: weather.js says 'Retrying when the live connection reconnects' but with a healthy WebSocket nothing retries; add a timed retry or change the text.

findings.label: Silent 10000-row truncation at 30 d
findings.detail: Stations reporting more often than ~4.3 min lose the oldest part of the 30 d range with no indication; note truncation when data.length === 10000.
